_about: Territories the campaign tracker knows: income and the boon that can be taken instead. The tracker's own copy, separate from the site's rules.

Heaviside Hab-layer (Settlement).boon: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0)

Pyroclave (Promethium Cache).boon: instead of income, add three hazard suits to the Stash for free

Rippershop (Rogue Doc Shop).boon: instead of income, if the gang has no Rogue Doc, recruit one for 30 credits less

Tallow Wick (Settlement).boon: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0)

Hollowpoint (Bullet Den).boon: instead of income, if the gang has no Ammo-Jack, recruit one for 30 credits less
